summary: Audit only: no behavior-preserving change possible without altering constructor/signatures. CLEAN.
findings: ReorderingService holds a single injected ReorderBuffer shared by every subscription of windows(); concurrent or repeated subscriptions share mutable buffer state. Fixing needs a per-subscription buffer factory (constructor signature change) - out of scope.
Clock is read per element inside concatMapIterable and the drain is deferred, so no state is captured at assembly time; pipeline itself is cold and stateless.
